Sam (partnerships): Quick sync: we need an onboarding checklist + minimal IAM/KMS examples for AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace listings. Aim: pilot with one publisher in 2 weeks. Owners?

Rina (eng): I can do TF + SA examples. We'll ask publishers to create publisher-owned keys and a role/service-account that Redwood can assume.

Tom (legal): OK on publisher-owned keys. I'll draft a short contract appendix: CMK access limited to activation, audit logs retained 90 days, and trial data retention 30 days.

Jules (product): Trial lengths: AWS/GCP 14d, Azure 21d. Auto-provision demo tenant for trial unless publisher opts out. Need a 1-page checklist for publishers.

onboard-bot: Created draft vault path: vault:/mp/onboard/pilotco (expires 14d).

Sam (partnerships): Plan: Rina TF samples by Fri, Tom clause by Mon, Jules picks pilot. I'll circulate calendar invite for a 30m handoff. Thanks everyone.
